name: Interactive Fluid Mask
description: Full-screen image hidden behind a lettered mask that is revealed by the cursor, with a liquid flowmap distortion that follows pointer movement and fades out.
contents: Full-viewport WebGL canvas showing a background image
SVG lettering mask in a solid color over the canvas
Spinner shown until the image has loaded
behavior: Mouse or touch movement paints a flowmap that distorts the image with RGB-split ripples
Distortion dissipates over time after the pointer stops
Mask fades out once the image texture is loaded
editableByProps: Background image, mask and lettering colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the distortion strength or color split
Change the image aspect ratio used for cover fitting

fixed: Lettering shape is a hardcoded SVG
Image is assumed to be 2048x1638 for cover fitting
Pointer listeners are attached to window
Canvas sizes to the full window, not its container
